seaView.holdTip: Stop where you are and wait for orders.
seaView.withdrawTip: Break off and make for open water.
seaView.howto.title: How to command at sea
seaView.howto.intro: W A S D steer · hold Space to draw, let go to loose
seaView.howto.steer: W makes way, S slows and backs water, A and D turn. She has weight: give her time.
seaView.howto.loose: Hold: a mark runs out from the side facing the enemy. Let go as it lies on her hull. Lead a moving ship.
seaView.howto.board: Lie close alongside at her speed and throw grapnels. A galley rams by sailing into her.
seaView.howto.helm: Take the helm of another ship. The rest keep station on you and shoot by themselves.
seaView.howto.mouse: Pick other ships and send them at an enemy, or to a spot.
seaView.howto.pause: Pause, the battle menu, follow your ship again.
